attr.title: Everlasting Summer
attr.desc: A visual novel about a week in a Soviet pioneer camp, where Semyon wakes up after falling asleep on a winter bus.
attr.inst: Get the game for free on Steam. Run tools/prepare_gamefiles.py on your PC against the install folder, or copy the contents of its game folder into ports/everlastingsummer/game.
attr.inst_md: Get the game for free on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/331470/). Run `tools/prepare_gamefiles.py` on a PC against the install folder (recommended, shrinks the assets for 640x480 screens), or copy the contents of its `game/` folder into `ports/everlastingsummer/game/`.
